newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Kitsa loading 35,000 tonnes soybeans/meal. Polska Walczaka loading 50,000 tonnes soymeal. New Spirit loading 43,090 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load soybeans and two to load soymeal.
Road: 625 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on July 10, as well as 325 trucks with soymeal and 112 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Suerte loading 44,800 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Panormos loading 30,000 tonnes soybeans. No vessels waiting to dock.
Road: 10 trucks carrying 257 tonnes soybeans and 34 trucks carrying 927 tonnes soymeal arrived on July 10.
Rail: 124 wagons arrived carrying 7,231 tonnes soybeans.
